composition_subtypes.role: Enumerate suffix i from 0 to 99-K to handle last two digits without carry
Construct minimal prefix with required digit sum by ordering remainder then 9s

payload.core_composition_summary: Brute-force over possible two-digit suffixes, then greedily build smallest prefix with required digit sum.
payload.rationale: The solution loops over suffixes to prevent carry into the prefix, then uses the standard greedy digit ordering (smallest first, then 9s) to minimize the number.
